title: Smooth evidence flow
details: Video prompt timestamps are listed clearly in evidence PDFs
After evidence saves, Evia shows Evidence saved for two seconds and then asks What did you learn?
The learner's reflection is saved with the evidence before Evia returns to the home screen
Page, option and back navigation use smooth fade-out and fade-in transitions
summary: Evia v158 adds the smooth post-evidence flow, cleaner navigation fades and video timestamp lists in evidence PDFs.
